messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning an overnight slim kernel rollout (kernel-abi v2.3.1, quant build q20260319-7). Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Deploybot scheduled a swap at 02:15. Need a concise ops checklist + explicit rollback criteria before we flip. cc @maria @samir :eyes:

maria: Got it. I can own smoke validation and release notes bullets. Which canary slice are we doing?

alex: Start with 5% regional canary (us-west-2) -> 25% after 15m if health ok -> full. If any p50 latency regresses >15% or error rate >0.5% for 10m, we stop and revert.

samir: Re: smoke tests: staging had a flake on long-seq tokenization with q20260319-7. Short-term mitigation: cap seq at 128 for canary. I'll add a guard in the smoke harness.

leo: Ops checklist draft:
- preflight: ensure all nodes report abi v2.3.0 baseline
- prebake: push q20260319-7 to canary pool
- run smoke (health + short gen + kvcache-check)
- monitor: traces, p50/p99, errors, eviction rate, kv-cache hitrate
- rollback: exec `deploybot swap --to kernel-abi:v2.3.0 --reason \"canary-fail\"`
- post: annotate dashboards and close change ticket

alex: include a TTL for pins? thinking 2h sticky pin after full rollout to avoid automatic swaps during hotfix window.

riley: I'm oncall during the window and can monitor dashboards. I'll keep a pager policy if rollback needed.

maria: Release note bullets (short):
- Engine: kernel-abi v2.3.1 — improved attention kernel for small-batch throughput
- Quant: q20260319-7 — narrower FP->int path, expect ~12% token cost reduction
- Known: long-seq tokenization edge-case; cap seq to 128 for canary

alex: Good. Samir, add the cap into the smoke script and push commit hash here. Also add a quick `kubectl` health check snippet we can run from oncall.

samir: Pushed fix: commit 3f9a7b2. Smoke commands:
```
# health
kubectl -n runtime exec deploy/runtime-smoke -- curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/health
# short gen
python infra/smoke/run.py --model redwood/small --seq 64 --commit 3f9a7b2
```

leo: Canary run plan timeline:
- 02:15 deploybot swap into canary pool (5%)
- 02:30 smoke + 15m observation
- 02:45 expand to 25% if green
- 03:15 full expansion if stable

alex: Rollback decision tree (short):
1) If canary smoke fails -> immediate rollback to v2.3.0 via deploybot command above, abort expansion.
2) If production p50 > baseline *1.15 or error >0.5% sustained 10m -> initiate rollback and pin previous abi.
3) If kv-cache eviction increases >2x or hitrate drops >10% -> investigate; consider rollback.

riley: I'll set alerts: p50, p99, errors, kv-eviction, kv-hitrate, cpu/gpu util on canary hosts. If any alert fires, I will DM the channel and escalate.

maria: Who's writing the 'post-rollout' short note and adding the release-note PR? alex?

alex: I'll draft the post-rollout note during the window and send PR to /docs/release-notes with the bullets.

deploybot: deploybot: swap scheduled for 1745012100 (02:15 UTC). To cancel: `deploybot cancel 1745012100`

alex: final check — Sarah mentioned a dependency on kernel-abi for metric exporter? (not in thread) If anyone hears otherwise, shout now. Otherwise proceed with plan.

samir: No blocker from metric exporter team, checked with them earlier.

maria: I'll create the change ticket and add checkboxes for smoke commit 3f9a7b2, dashboard links, and rollback commands.

alex: Thanks all. We'll post short postmortem if anything odd happens. If all green, close and mark as legacy. :thumbsup:
